import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

X_train = train_df.drop([id_col, target_col], axis=1)
y_train = train_df[target_col] - 1

X_test = test_df.drop(id_col, axis=1)
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Log transform distance columns (add small value to handle zeros)
print("Applying log transformations...")
distance_cols = [
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology",
    "Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology",
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways",
    "Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points",
]

for col in distance_cols:
    X_train[f"log_{col}"] = np.log1p(X_train[col])
    X_test[f"log_{col}"] = np.log1p(X_test[col])

# Elevation interaction with log-transformed distances
print("Creating elevation-log features...")
interaction_cols = []

X_train["Elev_log_Hydrology"] = (
    X_train["Elevation"] * X_train["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
)
X_train["Elev_log_Roads"] = (
    X_train["Elevation"] * X_train["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"]
)
X_train["Elev_log_Fire"] = (
    X_train["Elevation"] * X_train["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"]
)

X_test["Elev_log_Hydrology"] = (
    X_test["Elevation"] * X_test["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
)
X_test["Elev_log_Roads"] = (
    X_test["Elevation"] * X_test["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"]
)
X_test["Elev_log_Fire"] = (
    X_test["Elevation"] * X_test["log_Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"]
)

# Aspect features - create sine/cosine transformations for cyclical nature
X_train["Aspect_sin"] = np.sin(np.radians(X_train["Aspect"]))
X_train["Aspect_cos"] = np.cos(np.radians(X_train["Aspect"]))
X_test["Aspect_sin"] = np.sin(np.radians(X_test["Aspect"]))
X_test["Aspect_cos"] = np.cos(np.radians(X_test["Aspect"]))

# Slope binning
print("Creating slope bins...")
X_train["Slope_bin"] = pd.cut(
    X_train["Slope"],
    bins=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50, 100],
    labels=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    include_lowest=True,
)
X_test["Slope_bin"] = pd.cut(
    X_test["Slope"],
    bins=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50, 100],
    labels=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    include_lowest=True,
)

# Distance ratios
print("Creating distance ratio features...")
X_train["Roads_to_Hydrology"] = X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] / (
    X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_train["Fire_to_Hydrology"] = X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] / (
    X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_test["Roads_to_Hydrology"] = X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] / (
    X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)
X_test["Fire_to_Hydrology"] = X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] / (
    X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] + 1
)

# Identify categorical features
categorical_features = X_train.columns[
    X_train.columns.str.contains("Wilderness", na=False)
].tolist()

# Select all non-id columns as features
feature_cols = [col for col in X_train.columns if col != id_col]

# Split training data for validation (non-stratified to avoid class imbalance issues)
val_ratio = 0.2
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train[feature_cols],
    y_train,
    test_size=val_ratio,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    shuffle=True,
    stratify=None,  # Removed stratification to avoid ValueError with underrepresented classes
)

# Prepare DataFrames for LGBM
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(
    X_tr,
    label=y_tr,
    feature_name=feature_cols,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val,
    label=y_val,
    feature_name=feature_cols,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
    reference=lgb_train,
)

# Define parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(y_train.unique()),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_boost_round": 500,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": RANDOM_STATE,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "device": "cpu",
    "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 0.1,
}

# Train model
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=params["num_boost_round"],
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False, first_metric_only=True),
        lgb.log_evaluation(0),
    ],
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_preds = val_preds.argmax(axis=1)

# Transform predictions back to 1-indexed
val_preds_transformed = val_preds + 1
acc_score = accuracy_score(y_val + 1, val_preds_transformed)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {acc_score:.6f}")

# Generate submission on test set
print("Generating submission...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_preds = test_preds.argmax(axis=1)

# Transform predictions back to 1-indexed
test_preds_transformed = test_preds + 1

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_preds_transformed})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
